print.title: How do you print?
print.sub: Your page template is prepared from these answers.

paperTypeHint.plain: The cut line is printed and you cut it.
paperTypeHint.precut: The cut line is not printed, only shown on screen.

cutterHint.silhouette: The machine's software adds the marks; a cut file is provided.
cutterHint.cricut: The machine's software adds the marks; a cut file is provided.
cutterHint.scanncut: The cut line is printed, no marks.
cutterHint.plotter: L marks are printed in four corners; a cut file is provided.
cutterHint.other: The cut line is printed, no marks.

print.stickerHint: Largest width; diameter for round stickers.
